text: 瑞为技术(7656.HK)午后拉升，最终收涨10.48%报27.4港元，市值83.65亿港元。 瑞为技术是港交所18C章特专科技规则下首家以"视觉具身智能"定位上市的企业，兼具"AI+垂直场景+具身延伸"三重叙事，此前资本市场并无同类标的可供对标。根据弗若斯特沙利文的资料，按2025年的收入计，公司在中国民航企业视觉智能产品市场排名第一，市场份额为8.7%，并在中国商业空间企业视觉智能产品市场排名第四，市场份额为1.7%。 国元国际指出，2023年至2025年公司营收从2.42亿元增长至4.43亿元，复合年增长率达35.2%。其中智能商业收入从2023年
text_en: Raywell Technology (7656.HK) surged in afternoon trading, closing up 10.48% at 27.4 Hong Kong dollars, with a market cap of 8.365 billion Hong Kong dollars. Raywell Technology is the first company listed under the Hong Kong Stock Exchange's Chapter 18C special technology rules with a 'visual embodied intelligence' positioning, combining 'AI + vertical scenarios + embodied extension.' There was previously no comparable listed company. According to Frost & Sullivan, based on 2025 revenue, the company ranked first in China's civil aviation enterprise visual intelligence product market with an 8.7% share, and fourth in China's commercial space enterprise visual intelligence product market with a 1.7% share.
